layers.note: A local small tree of the driest rocky bluffs and balds around Puget Sound.

heat_load.note: Warm, sunny ground; favours slopes facing south and west.

elevation_m.note: Sea level to about 1,200 m in western Washington; the upper limits are loose.

max_slope_deg.note: Clings to steep bluffs and rock outcrops.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set niche values
sources.licence: project contribution under the repository's terms

provenance.notes: Authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands; not yet checked against the public-domain USDA references (Silvics of North America, the Fire Effects Information System, PLANTS).
